```{r include=FALSE}
require(tidyverse)
require(tigerstats)
require(mosaic)
davisdata <- read.csv(file="UCDavis.csv")
data=davisdata
```
 Our Goal is to answer this question Is there a difference between the alcohol consumed between the row
 you choose to sit in??

# introduction 
the question is this; is there relationship between where you sit in class and how much you drink?  
data from UCDavis math 116 class.  
$H_0$ there is no relationship between what row in class you sit and how much you drink.  
$H_A$ there is a difference between what row you sit in class and how much you drink.


# Methods 
seat is categorical 
alcohol is numerical 


# data summaries



## Now add in boxplot

```{r}
boxplot(alcohol~Seat,data=davisdata)
```

Graph demonstrates that if the student sits in the back they are more likely to consume more ounces per week of alcohol than the students who sit in the front or middle. 
  



## Numerical Summaries  

```{r}
favstats(alcohol~Seat,data=davisdata)
```

The numerical summary shows that the students who sit in the back drink about ten more ounces of alcohol than the students who sit in the middle and front seats who drink about 2 to 3 ounces of alcohol per week. 


## Inferential Tests

```{r}
model1 <- aov(alcohol~Seat,data=davisdata)
summary.aov(model1)
```
